method.description: Read originals independently; verified all 39 local files byte-for-byte against archive Git objects; ran eight independently written SQL queries directly on the original trace with the pinned processor. Compared actual parent IDs and identity, not time proximity.

queries.name: clock
queries.sql: SELECT snapshot_id,ts,clock_id,hex(clock_name) clock_name,clock_value,machine_id FROM clock_snapshot WHERE clock_id=6 ORDER BY snapshot_id;

queries.name: ime-slice-counts
metadata
queries.sql: SELECT hex(name) name,int_value,hex(str_value) str_value,machine_id FROM metadata WHERE name IN ('trace_time_clock_id','all_data_source_started_ns','tracing_disabled_ns','tracing_service_version','system_release','android_build_fingerprint') ORDER BY name;

queries.name: near-reset-main-thread
process-identity
queries.sql:
SELECT p.upid,p.pid,p.uid,hex(p.name) name,hex(p.cmdline) cmdline,p.start_ts,p.end_ts,p.machine_id,t.utid,t.tid,hex(t.name) thread_name,t.is_main_thread,t.start_ts thread_start_ts,t.end_ts thread_end_ts
FROM process p LEFT JOIN thread t ON t.upid=p.upid AND t.is_main_thread=1 WHERE p.uid=10112 OR p.name='com.android.inputmethod.latin' ORDER BY p.upid,t.utid;

queries.name: reset-lineage
queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE walk(reset_id,id,parent_id,hop) AS (
 SELECT id,id,parent_id,0 FROM slice WHERE name='IMS.resetStateForNewConfiguration'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.reset_id,s.id,s.parent_id,w.hop+1 FROM walk w JOIN slice s ON w.parent_id=s.id WHERE w.hop<100
)
SELECT w.reset_id,w.hop,s.id,s.parent_id,s.ts,s.dur,s.depth,s.track_id,hex(s.name) name,t.utid,t.upid,t.tid,t.is_main_thread,p.pid,p.uid,hex(p.name) process_name,hex(p.cmdline) cmdline,p.start_ts,p.end_ts,p.machine_id
FROM walk w JOIN slice s ON s.id=w.id LEFT JOIN thread_track tt ON tt.id=s.track_id LEFT JOIN thread t ON t.utid=tt.utid LEFT JOIN process p ON p.upid=t.upid ORDER BY w.reset_id,w.hop;

queries.name: stats
queries.sql: SELECT hex(name) name,idx,hex(severity) severity,hex(source) source,value FROM stats ORDER BY name,idx;

captureObservation.directCommandChecks: Original start returned exit 0 and PID 1862 after recorded 794/794 host PIPE bytes and EOF. Start and stop /proc stat show comm perfetto/startTicks2248, exact cmdline hashes agree, SIGINT command returned 0, own stop exit was recorded, pulled 4393006 bytes match remote digest. These support capture completion, not all reset call coverage or caller causality.

callerConclusion.reason: The sole observed reset slice is depth 0 with parent_id NULL on the bound IME main thread. The recursive parent-ID query has no ancestor. Neither configuration dispatch nor SettingsObserver entry is established.
boundaries: The same IME process contains four clientTransactionExecuted slices, but none is an ancestor of this reset. Their presence elsewhere does not classify the reset.
parent_id NULL means no captured parent slice; it does not prove no Java caller or distinguish an untraced configuration path from a settings callback.
IMS.initViews and IMS.showWindow children confirm the reset body performed traced work, not its caller.
Ten IMS.onComputeInsets slices were observed. The framework slice covers its traced base method, not every subclass geometry operation or every call.
Only one traced reset was observed. ImeTracker reset-show reasons and traced slices are not exhaustive counts of all reset invocations.
No timing correlation is promoted to SettingsObserver evidence. No absence is promoted to configuration exclusion.

clockMapping.mapping: trace ns == device BOOTTIME ns; compare raw elapsedRealtimeMs at millisecond precision

timing.limits: Trace ns and device elapsed markers share BOOTTIME, but raw/fixture markers are millisecond-floor values. The setting write is bracketed only by command order between A raw process finish and B raw process start. The interval includes 10 seconds without measuring a delayed task or proving SettingsObserver. No host UTC subtraction or host/device clock fit was used; the 8038ms callback gap is not continuous empty-region proof.

statsIndependentReview.explanation: The frozen analyzer admitted only info/error/data_loss; it rejected seven formally valid notice rows, all zero. Original archive remains unchanged. These zero notices are not evidence of actual trace loss.
statsIndependentReview.differenceExplanation: Only two info/analysis duration counters differ because trace parsing was executed again. All names/indices/severities and the error/data_loss/notice values match. CSV byte equality is not claimed for these runtime duration counters.
statsIndependentReview.zeroStatsLimit: No nonzero error/data_loss/notice was observed; this does not prove every call was instrumented or every Java caller was represented by a trace slice.

runtimeVersionBoundary: Actual trace reports service Perfetto v54.0 (N/A), Android17 API37 build CE2A.260420.051.A3/16571990, and kernel6.12.81-android16-6-g4f69fc7b210c-ab16167562. The processor is independently pinned v59.1. Prior v59.1 command source and android17-6.18 kernel source were reference evidence, not binary-equivalent image proof.

clock.conversion: Recorded elapsedRealtimeMs * 1000000 versus normalized trace BOOTTIME ns; millisecond timestamps have millisecond precision.

settingWriteDeviceBracket.lowerEvent: baseline raw result process.finishedElapsedMs recorded before baseline command returned
settingWriteDeviceBracket.upperEvent: enabled raw process.startedElapsedMs recorded after enable_setting command completed
settingWriteDeviceBracket.basis: The unchanged coordinator runs baseline to completion, then enable_setting, then enabled raw. The setting command has no device elapsed marker. These event-order bounds are all in the device boot-elapsed domain; no UTC fit is used.

limits: The 8038ms callback gap is absence of recorded callbacks, not continuous empty-region evidence.
The recorded 108.369898ms reset-to-positive difference uses a millisecond raw timestamp; it is not submillisecond measurement precision for the callback.
The setting-write bracket includes 10s but neither notification scheduling nor SettingsObserver entry was measured.
A reset slice with no parent does not identify SettingsObserver or exclude other configuration delivery paths.
Existing original Notes tests were not rerun and their confirmation-preparation deadline has a different origin.
Source clocks and normalized trace clocks support elapsed-domain comparison; no inference uses device wall-clock strings or host UTC as a common clock.

acceptanceBoundary: This run completed bounded capture and the diagnostic A/B comparison: A had no positive callback; B had one at show+8648ms; setting restoration was confirmed. It did not rerun the original 32 Notes cases, establish its original 5-second acceptance, establish device-phone compatibility, or solve the reset caller question.
